articles.title: Privacy coins face diverging fortunes as KuCoin moves to drop Monero
articles.snippet: As KuCoin joins exchanges dropping Monero ahead of new EU restrictions, Grayscale argues that Zcash’s privacy design sets it apart.

articles.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
articles.snippet: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

articles.title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody suffers data breach
articles.snippet: Zodia Custody’s CEO said the breach exposed names and email addresses of some clients and employees and was detected by the company Monday.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF November outflows top $5B, Morgan Stanley bucks trend
articles.snippet: The Morgan Stanley Bitcoin Trust drew $114.1 million in monthly net inflows through Wednesday, while US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows reached $5.39 billion.

articles.title: Senate Democrats urge SEC to scrap crypto, tokenized stock exemptions
articles.snippet: US Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen, among others, have taken aim at two recent SEC efforts to ease regulatory requirements for the crypto industry.
